name: gizza-ai/filter-lines
summary: Keep or drop lines matching a substring or regex

tool.description: Filter text line by line, like grep. Keep (mode=keep, default) or drop (mode=drop) every line that matches a pattern. The pattern is a literal substring by default, or a regular expression when regex=true; set ignore_case=true to match case-insensitively. Returns the filtered text plus total/matched/kept line counts. Runs locally.

text.description: The text whose lines should be filtered.

pattern.description: The substring (or regular expression, if regex=true) to match against each line.

mode.description: keep = output only matching lines; drop = output only non-matching lines.

regex.description: Treat the pattern as a regular expression instead of a literal substring.
